tasks.description: Calculate the average temperature and humidity for each hour and store the results in the local SQLite database.
Compute a 3-sample (15‑minute) moving average for temperature and humidity and append the values to the data stream for smoothing.
Classify each reading into comfort bands (e.g., comfortable, warm, hot) using a simplified heat index formula based on temperature_c and humidity_percent.
Detect abrupt changes where temperature shifts >2 °C or humidity shifts >5 % within a 10‑minute window and raise a local alert.
Predict the next 5‑minute temperature and humidity values using exponential smoothing (α=0.3) and log the forecast for quick trend monitoring.
